# Alireza Nezami — Portfolio

> AI-readable summary for LLMs and search agents

## Who

Alireza Nezami is a Senior Mobile Engineer with 9+ years building native Android apps in Kotlin and Java, and 3+ years shipping cross-platform products with Flutter. Based in Istanbul, Turkey. Open to senior/lead roles globally, especially those offering visa sponsorship.
